title: Geography coverage and Texas QPR examples
scope: matched government identities in existing public F31 snapshots, not all cities in every report

sources.national: Observed reporting quarters 2002Q2–2025Q1. Export filename date is not a verified extraction date.
sources.texas: 2026-02-03 F31 export; September 2026 extraction repair; contains 2026Q1

limitations: Government responsibility is not beneficiary geography; boundaries are references.
The national and Texas F31 snapshots overlap. Select only one snapshot and never add relationship roles.
Unmatched organizations are not assigned a location. This index does not cover every city in every report.
QPRs may omit activities and snapshots do not add to F31 or cumulative quarters.
The Santa Rosa source/census legal-name discrepancy is unresolved. The 2018 Floods QPR is a multi-award group; grant-specific expenditure is unavailable.
Grant start, award-relative horizon and compatible activity allocation are unverified for these new QPR examples.
Of 1,077 source-QPR rows, financial cells on 19 original pages were visually checked; the other 1,058 were checked against two text readers and still need individual financial page review.
Cook, Dearborn and Dallas: 50 selected rows; 15 original pages visually reviewed; direct-household Cook records held out. Combined reports do not establish award-specific expenditure.

Responsible-government names were matched to current Census identifiers using sampled QPR pages, then applied by exact label across records; historical continuity and beneficiary geography are unverified. Combes, Laguna Vista, Primera, Santa Rosa and Woodloch city/town wording conflicts remain unresolved. West Orange/Vidor and Daisetta/Raymondville narrative discrepancies are flagged.

field_overrides.source_rows: Count of original F31 rows within the stated snapshot, role and grant; not a funding amount and not additive across roles or snapshots.
field_overrides.activity_attribute_versions: Count of source activity-attribute versions, not necessarily unique activity IDs.
field_overrides.beneficiary_geography: Unavailable; not inferred from administering or responsible entity.
field_overrides.identity_status: Describes exact source-to-government linkage or an explicit unresolved conflict.
field_overrides.reporting_group: Identifier printed in QPR; may combine multiple awards.
field_overrides.grant_id: Original grant identifier only for a verified single-grant report; blank for the multi-award report.
field_overrides.expended_period_cents: QPR total funds expended in the report period, in signed nominal USD cents; multi-award report totals are not split.
field_overrides.expended_to_date_cents: QPR total funds expended to date, in signed nominal USD cents; do not add cumulative periods.

cook_named_village_reference.boundary_vintage: 2025 Census cartographic place or county subdivision
cook_named_village_reference.limitation: A reference boundary is not a project footprint or beneficiary allocation; unincorporated township scope describes only a part.
